title: All Planets Fit Between Earth and Moon

segments.text: Every other planet can fit… right here.
This is the empty gap between Earth and the Moon.
When the Moon is farthest away, the gap is almost 400,000 kilometers.
Let's fill it. Jupiter slams in first, 143,000 kilometers wide.
Then Saturn, 120,000. Uranus and Neptune, about 50,000 each.
Venus, Mars and tiny Mercury squeeze in last.
That's every planet, side by side… and they all fit!
There's even over 9,000 kilometers to spare.
So the Moon isn't close at all. Space is just that big.
And every planet fits… right here.
